text: {"v":1,"stage":"final","look":"Stacked tiles: large pale split tiles rise over one another, copy on the left, a live Nucleux component scene on the right (the user's brief: light neutral, Nucleux purple, Clay-like overlap)","palettes":[["#FAFAF9","#8B5CF6","#0B0B0A","#3B82F6"]],"theirs":1,"width":1920,"height":1080,"fps":60,"background":"#FFFFFF","fonts":{"sans":{"family":"Inter","or":"instrument-sans","weights":[400,500,600,700]},"mono":{"family":"JetBrains Mono","or":"dm-mono"}},"scenes":[{"id":"intro","name":"Prompt to preview","dur":5.55,"desc":"The concept home's intro: the NUCLEUX wordmark draws, fills and glides into its slot; the headline blurs in over the hero gradient; tile one rises."},{"id":"describe","name":"Describe it","dur":3.5,"desc":"Tile one: the request is typed into the composer, sent, and Claude hands off to Nucleux."},{"id":"patterns","name":"Find patterns","dur":4,"desc":"Tile two rises over tile one: the request pulses to Nucleux and three matching components are picked."},{"id":"build","name":"Build and review","dur":6.5,"desc":"Tile three rises: the project dashboard assembles and waits for review."},{"id":"outro","name":"Start exploring","dur":4,"desc":"End card: the tiles drop away, the NUCLEUX wordmark glides to the centre, Start exploring under it, then Explore nucleux.in and the install command."}]}
